The format of VRRF and payment details (i.e. f ees amount & Bank account details) is available in “Buyer uploaded ATC document” section of the Bid Document. 5. Place of Inspection & Authority: at O F Khamaria, Raw Material/Advance Sample/Bulk Quantity: CG M/(OF) KHAMARIA or his authorized representative. 6. Bidder shall submit all the documents as per bid ATC and if the bidder fails to do so, OFK reser ves the right o disqualify the bidder. Note: Eligible Bidders are requested to go through the attached Drawing, QAP/Specification and Te nder Terms & Conditions and should satisfy themselves before participating in the tender.
